title: Reviewing a draft report — Lakeside Dental Group
instructions: Review the draft unmodified auditor's report on **Lakeside Dental Group, LLC**, a private company, for the year ended December 31, Year 1, and the draft communication to the members' audit committee. Keep correct phrases; replace incorrect ones.

exhibits.title: Engagement facts
exhibits.content:
- Audit performed under GAAS; the firm is independent.
- Sufficient appropriate evidence was obtained on March 14, Year 2; the report will be released March 21, Year 2.
- No going concern issues. The auditor is not engaged to report key audit matters.
- During the audit, management and the auditor disagreed about the revenue recognition policy; management eventually adopted the auditor's view.

segments.explanation: The title must indicate an independent auditor's report.

segments.text: — **Opinion.** In our opinion, the accompanying financial statements present fairly, in all material respects, the financial position of Lakeside Dental Group, LLC as of December 31, Year 1 ... in accordance with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States of America. **Basis for Opinion.** We conducted our audit in accordance with

segments.original: the standards of the Public Company Accounting Oversight Board
options: the standards of the Public Company Accounting Oversight Board
auditing standards generally accepted in the United States of America
segments.answer: auditing standards generally accepted in the United States of America
segments.explanation: Private companies are audited under GAAS.

segments.text: . We are required to be independent of Lakeside Dental Group, LLC and to meet our other ethical responsibilities. **Auditor's Responsibilities.** Our objectives are to obtain

segments.explanation: Reasonable assurance is high but not absolute.

segments.text: about whether the financial statements as a whole are free from material misstatement. In performing an audit, we obtain an understanding of internal control relevant to the audit

segments.original: in order to express an opinion on the effectiveness of internal control
options: in order to express an opinion on the effectiveness of internal control
in order to design audit procedures that are appropriate in the circumstances, but not for the purpose of expressing an opinion on the effectiveness of internal control
segments.answer: in order to design audit procedures that are appropriate in the circumstances, but not for the purpose of expressing an opinion on the effectiveness of internal control
segments.explanation: No opinion on internal control is expressed in a financial statement audit.
Dated when sufficient appropriate evidence was obtained, not the release date.
